Change 0003 is **parked** at the deploy gate: one Important review finding is still open, and this run is not allowed to fix it. PR #16 is marked ready and labelled `sdlc:needs-human`: https://github.com/luissiviero/crypto-backtester/pull/16

**Why it parked**
- A fresh review of the current commit found 1 Important issue and 2 nits. The older review file was for an earlier commit, so it no longer counted.
- **The Important finding:** `CLAUDE.md` is out of date after this change.
  - Lines 5–6 still describe Binance data.
  - Line 30 still lists the deleted `vision` module.
  - Lines 36–37 still name `tests/binance_stub.py` and `tests/fixtures/binance/`, which are gone.
- `CLAUDE.md` is a guardrail file, so this run can't edit it. The panel that settles items like this has used all 4 of its 4 allowed calls, so it couldn't settle it either. The gate stopped there (exit 4).
- `plan.md` (lines 53–61) already gives the replacement text for each of those lines.
- Every other gate check passed. The build, test and lint commands are run by the runner after this session, not here, so I have no output from them to show.

**The 2 nits** (no action needed to pass the gate)
- `app/data/cache.py:122`: `cache-info --market futures --interval 6h` is accepted and lists nothing, instead of being refused. Futures doesn't offer `6h`.
- `app/data/rest.py:161` (the reviewer was unsure): for the current day on futures, KuCoin might answer the extra request with an older candle. If it does, every download that includes today would report today as a gap. This can't be checked offline.

**Done in this run**
- There was nothing to prepare as a release, because the deploy action is `none`. This isn't an incident change, so no lesson or test case was needed.
- I wrote the release notes, including a plain-words paragraph.
- I committed and pushed the gate evidence (commit `7c8af16`).
- I posted the review check run `sdlc/review` on the reviewed commit; it shows as failed with "1 Important, 2 nits".
- I updated the PR description.

**What I need from you:** either update `CLAUDE.md` yourself using the lines in `plan.md`, or accept the out-of-date text with a review comment on the PR. A review comment is the change request, so it starts `/sdlc-fix 0003`, which re-runs the review and the gate. Once the gate passes, your approving review is the deploy gate and the merge App merges on it. No production gate is declared, so no release label is needed.
